verdict.rationale: Mintlify automations run its agent on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on integration events. The agent opens pull requests for team review, and changes can be previewed, approved, and merged in the editor or via per-PR preview deployments. Rollback exists as instant deployment rollbacks, but only for Enterprise customers. All of this covers the outputs of automations through Git and deployments, not the automations themselves. Missing for 10: versioning or change history of automation definitions, review of automation configuration changes, rollback of automation settings themselves, rollback below the Enterprise tier, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
